unread.said: The passage southwest is choked with a fall of rock not far in. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.
unread.line: The passage southwest is choked with a fall of rock not far in. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.

unread.said: The passage northwest goes a little way and stops at a slide of broken rock that has come down from the roof lately and is still settling; a stone trickles out of it as you watch. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.
unread.line: The passage northwest goes a little way and stops at a slide of broken rock that has come down from the roof lately and is still settling; a stone trickles out of it as you watch. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.

unread.said: The passage south runs a dozen paces and ends in a fall of rock, floor to roof, with a cold draught coming through it that says there is a great deal more on the other side. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.
unread.line: The passage south runs a dozen paces and ends in a fall of rock, floor to roof, with a cold draught coming through it that says there is a great deal more on the other side. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait.

unread.said: You start up toward the ledge, and the rock comes away in your hand, and a good deal more of it follows. The way up has gone, for now. Whatever is along there will have to wait.
unread.line: You start up toward the ledge, and the rock comes away in your hand, and a good deal more of it follows. The way up has gone, for now. Whatever is along there will have to wait.
